title: testOS Benchmark Result
description: Per-benchmark result written by the testOS guest runner (one <bench-id>.json file per benchmark). The canonical identifier is bench_id; it MUST equal the result file's name stem. bench_name is a human-readable label that may legitimately differ from bench_id (e.g. bench_id='iperf3-tcp', bench_name='iperf3 TCP throughput'); validators must therefore key on bench_id, never on bench_name. Schema version is frozen at 1; future versions must bump schema_version and the validator must refuse mismatched versions.

bench_id.description: Canonical benchmark id from the catalog. MUST equal the result file's name stem (e.g. iperf3-tcp.json -> bench_id='iperf3-tcp').

bench_name.description: Human-readable benchmark name. May differ from bench_id; not used as an identity key.

scenario.description: Manifest scenario this benchmark contributes to (e.g. 'server-throughput').

value.description: Primary numeric result (e.g. IOPS, TPS, latency p95 in ms). Required and finite for passing numeric benchmarks; null/absent for pass/fail or failed benchmarks.

unit.description: Unit of value (e.g. 'iops', 'tps', 'ms', 'gbps'). Required for passing numeric benchmarks.
